reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: Whipple triad plus high C peptide proves endogenous insulin excess
Three Ps (parathyroid, pituitary, pancreas) define MEN1
Diabetic nephropathy nodules are Kimmelstiel Wilson lesions
Silent myocardial infarction follows diabetic autonomic neuropathy
reference.pathophysiology: Autoimmune insulitis or insulin resistance with glucolipotoxic beta cell failure sustains hyperglycaemia whose glycation products, haemodynamic stress and growth factors scar retina, glomeruli, nerves and large arteries. Pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours secrete hormones by cell type, and menin or RET lesions syndromically multiply endocrine tumours.
additionalDifferentials: Insulinoma versus exogenous insulin hypoglycaemia by C peptide
additionalInvestigations: HbA1c with glucose criteria and islet autoantibodies in classification doubt
Urine albumin creatinine ratio and retinal screening annually
Insulin with C peptide during documented hypoglycaemia
